title: 第003章 七罪堕天莉莉丝第004章 虚空试炼 深渊
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 苏业挣扎着从莉莉丝那广阔的胸怀中挣扎了出来。
大口呼吸了几口，差点被闷死，就是有点顶不住。
“神皇大人难道是在嫌弃莉莉丝吗？”莉莉丝脸上带着楚楚可怜的表情看向苏业。
苏业这个时候才看清楚莉莉丝的全貌，不由的让苏业想到了八尺夫人，自己一米八五的身高也才堪堪抵达莉莉丝的胸口。
莉莉丝的身高虽然高，但是并不臃肿，反而给人一种恰到合适的丰腴，多一分嫌胖，少一分嫌瘦。
精致绝美的脸蛋再加上那高挑丰满的身材，简直就是绝杀，尤其是那一双大长腿，苏业感觉比自己的命还长。
一对黑紫色的羽翼，身上穿着一身黑色的长裙。
“神皇大人，是看呆了吗？如果神皇大人想的话，莉莉丝也可以的。”莉莉丝脸上带着羞涩的出现在苏业的面前。
水汪汪的眸子带着热烈的爱意蹲在苏业的面前，丝毫不在意自己暴露在了苏业的眼中。
“咳咳，这个晚点再说，我先看看你的属性莉莉丝。”苏业咳嗽了一声转移了一下目光，有点顶不住。
“那神皇大人可要好好调查调查啊。”莉莉丝直接趴在了苏业的身上，在苏业的耳边轻声的说道。
苏业定了定神，真是一个妖精，看向莉莉丝的属性面板。
姓名：莉莉丝
忠诚度：100（恒定）
等级：黑铁1星
兵种：七罪堕天—莉莉丝（英雄单位）
阵营：混乱
天赋：七大罪
技能：原罪之焰
神器：七罪战镰
潜力：根源！
ps：一个本不该诞生的存在，一个奇迹，一个传说，以前不会有，以后也不会再有的唯一奇迹！
“一个奇迹，一个传说，唯一的存在？”苏业看着莉莉丝的面板深吸了一口气。
现在莉莉丝才刚刚招募出来，等级还是太低了，具体看不出来，不过刚招募出来就有着自己的神器就足以说明一切。（等级太低，后续会慢慢解放！）
“根源？有这个级别的存在吗？”苏业皱了皱眉不由的想到。
兵种的等级分为：黑铁，青铜，白银，黄金，铂金，钻石，圣域，传说，史诗，传奇，半神，神明！
这就是苏业知道的所有兵种等级了，至于神明之上的等级苏业可以肯定有，但是自己还不清楚。
潜力就代表着一个兵种的上限等级。
苏业看向了另外九道身影，同样也查看了起来。
姓名：原罪堕天使
忠诚度：100（恒定）
等级：黑铁1星
兵种：傲慢-堕天使，贪婪-堕天使，色欲-堕天使，嫉妒-堕天使，暴食-堕天使，暴怒-堕天使，懒惰-堕天使（普通单位）
阵营：混乱
天赋：傲慢，贪婪，色欲，嫉妒，暴食，暴怒，懒惰！
技能：傲慢之重，贪婪之手，色欲之诱，嫉妒之刃，暴食之噬，暴怒之斧，懒惰之囚
神器：傲慢-剑，贪婪-匕，色欲-鞭，嫉妒-刀，暴食-锤，暴怒-斧，懒惰-镰
content_en:
Su ye struggled to get out of Lilith's broad mind.
I took a few big breaths and almost suffocated to death, but I just couldn't hold it in any longer.
"Does the God Emperor dislike Lilith?" Lilith looked at Su Ye with a pitiful expression on her face.
Only then did Su ye see Lilith's whole face clearly, and he couldn't help but think of Mrs. Bachi. His own height of 1.85 meters could only reach Lilith's chest.
Although Lilith is tall, she is not bloated. Instead, she has just the right amount of plumpness. Any more would be too fat, and any less would be too thin.
The delicate and beautiful face coupled with the tall and plump figure is simply a killer, especially the long legs. Su ye feels that his life is longer than his own.
A pair of black and purple wings, wearing a long black dress.
"Lord God Emperor, are you stunned? If Lord God Emperor wants, Lilith can do it too." Lilith appeared in front of Su ye with a shy face.
With watery eyes and passionate love, she squatted in front of Su ye, not caring that she was exposed to Su ye's eyes.
"Ahem, we'll talk about this later. Let me take a look at your attribute Lilith first." Su ye coughed and shifted his gaze, a little unable to bear it.
"Then the God Emperor must investigate carefully." Lilith lay directly on Su ye's body and whispered in Su ye's ear.
Su ye calmed down, what a fairy, and looked at Lilith's attribute panel.
Name: Lilith
Loyalty: 100 (constant)
Level: Black Iron 1 star
Unit: Seven Sins - Lilith (hero unit)
Alignment: Chaos
Talent: Seven Deadly Sins
Skill: Flame of Original Sin
Artifact: Seven Sins Scythe
Potential: Roots!
ps: An existence that should not have been born, a miracle, a legend, the only miracle that never existed before and will never happen again!
"A miracle, a legend, the only existence?" Su ye looked at Lilith's panel and took a deep breath.
Lilith has just been recruited now, and her level is still too low to be specific. However, the fact that she has her own artifact right after she was recruited is enough to explain everything. (The level is too low, it will be gradually released later!)
"The source? Is there an existence of this level?" Su ye frowned and couldn't help but think.
The levels of arms are divided into: black iron, bronze, silver, gold, platinum, diamond, sanctuary, legend, epic, legend, demigod, and god!
These are all the military levels that Su ye knows about. As for the levels above gods, Su ye is sure there are them, but he doesn't know yet.
Potential represents the upper limit level of a unit.
Su ye looked at the other nine figures and also checked them.
Name: Original Sin Fallen Angel
Loyalty: 100 (constant)
Level: Black Iron 1 star
Troops: Pride - Fallen Angel, Greed - Fallen Angel, Lust - Fallen Angel, Envy - Fallen Angel, Gluttony - Fallen Angel, Wrath - Fallen Angel, Sloth - Fallen Angel (ordinary unit)
Alignment: Chaos
Talents: Arrogance, Greed, Lust, Envy, Gluttony, Wrath, Sloth!
Skills: Weight of Pride, Hand of Greed, Seduction of Lust, Blade of Envy, Bite of Gluttony, Ax of Wrath, Prisoner of Sloth
Artifacts: Pride - Sword, Greed - Dagger, Lust - Whip, Envy - Knife, Gluttony - Hammer, Wrath - Axe, Sloth - Sickle
